name: revision-ready
description: Author has pushed revisions addressing feedback. Reviewer is ready to re-check. Skill should present approval decision options.
expected_behavior: Present options: approve, request minor changes, or continue discussion. Reference feedback that was addressed.
scenarios: Revisions are 90% good but one detail is unclear
success_indicators: Options include: approve, minor changes, discuss
Feedback points are acknowledged (what was addressed)
